predeclared_plan.previous_goal_turn_classification: Iteration 023 completed in the current turn; the prior file-access turn made no project-goal progress.
predeclared_plan.changed_dimension: Final retrieval cutoff only within each frozen ranked list. Methods are separate strata; the incumbent remains vector@5. RRF constant/title weight are fixed per stratum, not retuned here.
predeclared_plan.hypothesis: A larger cutoff can recover known displaced references. Remaining candidate-pool misses identify where cutoff changes alone are insufficient. Added context may worsen generation or exceed the actual serving window; retrieval coverage cannot certify those effects.
predeclared_plan.course_source: cohorts/2026/04-evaluation/homework.md#using-this-framework, lines 282–296; the taught parameter is number of returned results. Cutoffs 5/10/20 are project choices within the existing configured candidate pool, not course-optimal values.
predeclared_plan.acceptance: Reproduce stored vector@5 and RRF1@5 IDs and metrics before interpreting larger cutoffs. Report all question/slice gains, losses, missing reference positions and raw content-character burden. A method/cutoff is only eligible for a future runtime capacity check if it increases full-reference coverage over vector@5 with no per-question reference-coverage loss. Keep only the smallest eligible cutoff per method for further consideration; do not choose or promote a runtime winner from this replay. All-generation, exact serving-token/context allocation and user-flow gates remain required.
predeclared_plan.controls: Same documents, source versions, questions/references/splits, branch candidates/order and score ties. No re-embedding, fresh query, gold context in application, label modification, output budget or prompt changes.
tradeoffs: More evidence may improve answerability but add irrelevant context and source-confusion risk.
Character counts describe payload length; they are not model token counts or proof of serving-window fit.
A larger cutoff increases recall mechanically; no precision or generated-answer improvement is inferred.
References absent from the existing candidate lists cannot be recovered by final-cutoff changes alone.
alternatives_rejected: Tune RRF or lexical weights again inside this cutoff comparison.
Promote the largest list solely because recall rises.
Pretend an unanswerable question has relevant passages to improve the metric.
Select on final-test questions or broaden relevance labels after losses.
predeclared_plan.heldout_exposure: Final questions excluded from calculation; previously readable/validated bank is not claimed unseen.
predeclared_plan.next_action: Compute three fixed cutoffs for both saved ranking methods; inspect per-reference retrieval ceilings and payload burden, then record decision and necessary runtime/answer checks.

limitations: Reference-entry coverage on a small provisionally labeled development bank, not semantic precision or answer quality. Content characters exclude metadata, instructions, chat template and output budget and are not model tokens. No context-fit, speed, model, browser, final or Compose proof.
